name: Vivace
description: Spectral warping wavetable synthesizer: three wavetable oscillators with spectral morph and phase warp, a sample source, two filters, six envelopes, eight LFOs, a 64-slot modulation matrix, nine effects, and a library of 187 wavetables in 14 types (any table a sound file carries can be taken into another sound). A port of open-source GPLv3 code (licenses/NOTICE)
author: rgeissen (Pung module), on GPLv3 open-source synthesis code (licenses/NOTICE)

assets.label: Presets
assets.description: Your own preset files (.vital, the JSON preset format of the synth this engine comes from). Each folder becomes a bank in SOUNDS, named after it; files at the top form the bank Presets. Vivace's own sounds are the Factory bank.
assets.hint: Wavetables travel inside the preset file: nothing else is needed, and every table your sounds carry is offered on an oscillator's Table page (From Presets). A sound asking for more than 16 voices or more than 2x oversampling is played with 16 and 2x.
